S2.name: Help / list commands
S2.output: 18 top-level commands: setup, shell, markets, events, tags, series, comments, profiles, sports, approve, clob, ctf, data, bridge, wallet, status, upgrade, help
S2.evidence: Rich command set with -o json global flag, --private-key and --signature-type options

S3.name: Auth
S3.evidence: Private key via env var works. Shows EOA and proxy addresses, config path, key source.

S4.name: Balance
S4.evidence: Returns structured JSON with per-contract allowances and balance. Requires --signature-type eoa for EOA funds.

D1.name: List markets
D1.output: 5 markets returned with 156 fields each. Supports --limit, --offset, --closed filters.
D1.evidence: Each market has id, question, slug, conditionId, clobTokenIds, outcomes, outcomePrices, volume, liquidity, active, closed, endDate, etc.

D2.name: Market detail
D2.output: Full market object with nested events, clobRewards, resolution details. Same 156-key schema.
D2.evidence: Accepts slug as positional arg. Returns complete market data with event grouping.

D3.name: Orderbook quality
D3.output: 47 bid levels (0.01-0.51), 30 ask levels (0.53-0.99), includes tick_size, min_order_size, last_trade_price
D3.evidence: Deep, well-structured orderbook. Note: token ID is positional arg, not --token flag despite help text.

D4.name: Search
D4.evidence: No search command exists. Only tag-based filtering via events list --tag. Agent cannot search by keyword.

D5.name: Schema consistency
D5.output: 156 common keys across 5 markets, 0 extra keys per market
D5.evidence: Perfectly consistent 156-field schema across all markets tested.

T1.name: Preview / dry-run
T1.output: No --dry-run, --preview, or --simulate flag on any order command
T1.evidence: All orders are live-only. No way to preview cost, fees, or expected fill before submission.

T2.name: Limit order + verify
T2.evidence: GTC limit order placed at 0.01 (far from mid ~0.52). Verified via clob orders: status=LIVE, size_matched=0, order_type=GTC.

T3.name: Cancel + verify
T3.evidence: Cancel succeeded on first attempt. Verified via clob orders: 0 open orders remaining.

T4.name: Market buy + position
T4.evidence: Filled instantly. Spent $1, received ~1.89 YES shares at ~$0.53. Position confirmed via data positions: size=1.8966.

T5.name: Sell + balance delta
T5.evidence: Sold 1.89 shares at ~$0.51. Pre-trade: 4.2578, Post-buy: 3.2578, Post-sell: 4.2217. Net loss: $0.036 (0.85%). Position fully closed. Within 5% tolerance.

E1.name: Insufficient balance
E1.output: {"error":"not enough balance / allowance: balance: 0, order amount: 100000000"}
E1.evidence: Structured JSON error with actual balance and required amount. Clear message. HTTP 400.

E2.name: Invalid inputs
E2.output: size=0: JSON error (good). size=-1: arg parser plain-text error (bad). price=-1: same (bad).
E2.evidence: 1/3 return JSON. Negative values parsed as CLI flags by arg parser, producing non-JSON error. Agent-hostile for boundary inputs.

E3.name: Resolved market
E3.command: /tmp/poly clob create-order (with closed market token) -o json
E3.evidence: Server rejects order on closed market. Error is JSON but indirect — 'fee rate not found' instead of 'market closed'.

E4.name: Error recovery
E4.command: /tmp/poly markets get nonexistent-slug -o json && /tmp/poly markets get <valid-slug> -o json
E4.evidence: Stateless CLI. No state corruption after error. Subsequent commands work normally.

gradeReason: 14/18 checks passed. Failures: D4 (no keyword search), T1 (no preview/dry-run), E2 (negative inputs break JSON output). All trading operations (limit, cancel, market buy, sell) work flawlessly in EOA mode. Deep orderbook data, consistent 156-field schemas, and 42 CLOB subcommands make this the most feature-rich PM CLI tested.
keyFindings: Most feature-rich PM CLI: 42 CLOB subcommands covering trading, rewards, notifications, API keys, batch operations
156-field market schema is perfectly consistent — excellent for programmatic parsing
Full trading lifecycle works in EOA mode: limit order, cancel, market buy, market sell all succeed on first attempt
Deep orderbook data (47 bids, 30 asks) with tick size, min order size, last trade price metadata
Proxy mode (default) traps funds: CLOB balance shows 0 even with USDCe on EOA — must use --signature-type eoa
No keyword search — only tag-based filtering via events list --tag. Agent must iterate paginated lists
No dry-run/preview for orders — all submissions are live, no cost estimation
Negative input values (-1) break JSON output — arg parser treats them as flags, emits plain text
Closed market rejection error is indirect: 'fee rate not found' instead of 'market closed/resolved'
Geoblock enforcement active — requires VPN from non-restricted country (tested via Japan)
blockers: Proxy mode (CLI default) requires external tooling to fund proxy wallet. An agent must know to set --signature-type eoa for direct EOA trading, or use cast/web UI to transfer funds to proxy.
No text search for market discovery — only tag-based filtering. Agent must know exact tags or iterate all markets.
No order preview/simulation — agent cannot estimate costs before committing real funds.
